summary.name: QuickAds
summary.one_liner: QuickAds is a paid social ad platform and managed service that uses a library of 32M+ ads to plan, produce (AI and influencer-led) and pre-test social video ads.
use_cases: Researching what ads are working in a category before briefing
Producing AI or influencer-led video ads for paid social
Pre-testing and publishing ad creative across platforms
Creating claims-compliant ads for regulated categories like supplements
Finding and running creator collaborations for ads
Outsourcing weekly paid social creative production
summary.what_it_does: QuickAds says it reads its library of 32M+ ads to suggest angles, hooks and storyboards for a brand, each tied to visible evidence. It produces AI and influencer-style video ads at 100+ per month with a stated 5-7 day turnaround from approved brief. It checks ads for compliance and conversion, pre-tests them, and publishes across channels, feeding results back into the next batch. A free Discover tier offers a category report and ad ideas; paid software adds AI image and video creation, publishing, and an influencer agent.
notable: Ad intelligence library of 32M+ ads used to guide creative decisions
Remy influencer agent for finding creators and running collaborations
MCP integration to create ads from your own AI assistant
Claims-safe creative built from an approved claims library
caveats: Managed creative starts at $5,000/mo or 5% of ad spend (whichever is higher), plus 2% for campaign management
Software starts at $199/mo, or $299/mo with AI agents, publishing and the influencer agent
Performance depends on the client's offer, spend and market; the page makes no guaranteed results
